summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload via alternate-runtime dropper
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs fetches the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` file with rotated string-array obfuscation (rotator function permuting a large mixed numeric/string constant array plus a custom charset-based decoder), so its behavior is opaque to Node-based static review. Fetching a separate language runtime purely to execute an in-tarball obfuscated blob at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and evades scanners that only trace Node-resolved code. The advertised purpose is a webpack typed-css-modules loader, which has no need for a Bun runtime or a math-themed payload; the filename `math_init.js` does not correspond to any advertised functionality. package.json also carries a scope mismatch: the package is published as `@ornikar/typed-css-modules-loader` while `repository.url` and `bugs.url` point at github.com/olegstepura/typed-css-modules-loader, an unrelated upstream that does not ship this preinstall machinery.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
